settings.agent.heading: AI Tools
settings.agent.intro: Claude can search and run your plugins: in the AI chat, and in Claude Desktop or Claude Code when you allow it. Actions that change something always ask you first, in the launcher window.
settings.agent.external: Allow AI apps to use golauncher
settings.agent.external.desc: Lets Claude Desktop and Claude Code use the plugins below through “golauncher mcp”. The AI chat in the launcher does not need this.
settings.agent.open: Opening apps, links and folders, copying
settings.agent.open.desc: Changes, such as installing or ending a process, always ask; destructive actions always ask.
settings.agent.plugins.desc: Clipboard history is off unless you turn it on; sensitive clips are never shared. Plugins from other developers are off until you turn them on.
settings.agent.desktop.desc: Adds golauncher to Claude Desktop's configuration (only the “golauncher” entry; a backup is made first). Restart Claude Desktop afterwards.
settings.agent.desktop.other: Connected to another copy of golauncher.
settings.agent.desktop.notInstalled: Claude Desktop does not seem to be installed.
settings.agent.desktop.done: Updated {{.path}}. Restart Claude Desktop to use golauncher.
settings.agent.desktop.offHint: Also turn on “Allow AI apps to use golauncher” above.

settings.agent.activity.desc.one: {{.Count}} tool call in the last 30 days. Open “AI Activity” in the launcher to see them.
settings.agent.activity.desc.other: {{.Count}} tool calls in the last 30 days. Open “AI Activity” in the launcher to see them.

settings.actions.heading: AI Actions
settings.actions.intro: The AI actions offered for the selected text and for files dropped on the launcher, in this order. Nothing is sent until you choose one.
settings.actions.restore.title: Restore the built-in actions?
settings.actions.restore.message: The built-in actions get back their names, prompts, order and switches. Your own actions are kept.
settings.actions.dialog.builtinNote: A built-in action: you can change its name and prompt; Restore Defaults puts them back.
settings.actions.field.title: Name
settings.actions.field.prompt.help: Placeholders: {selection} the selected text (without it, the text follows the prompt as a quote), {lang} the target language of Translate, {input} what you type for the action, {app} the app the text was selected in, {date} today's date.
settings.actions.field.mode.help: Shows the result: only the answer, Enter pastes it (replacing the selected text when it can be edited), Tab follows up in a chat.
settings.actions.field.keywords.help: Optional, separated by commas: more words that find the action when you type.
settings.actions.field.minLength.help: Optional: shown only for selected text at least this many characters long.
settings.actions.problem.minLength: The minimum length is a whole number of characters.
settings.backends.heading: Backends
settings.backends.intro: The programs the AI chat runs. When one is installed more than once, golauncher chooses one automatically; you can choose another.
settings.backends.missing: The chosen program {{.path}} no longer exists, so golauncher uses the one it finds automatically.
settings.backends.other.shadowed: version {{.version}}, not used: another one is found first
settings.backends.custom.label: Path of the program
settings.backends.custom.notFound: There is no file at this path.
settings.backends.custom.tooOld: Version {{.version}} is too old: {{.backend}} needs {{.min}} or newer.
settings.backends.custom.failed: It did not print its version: {{.err}}

settings.title: golauncher Settings
settings.permissions.intro: macOS asks before golauncher may read or control other apps. Grant these in System Settings › Privacy & Security; golauncher works without them, with fewer features.
settings.permissions.terminal: When golauncher is started from a terminal (go run, or a binary that is not in a .app), macOS asks for and records these permissions for that terminal app (Terminal, iTerm2…), not for golauncher: grant them to the terminal, then restart golauncher.
settings.permissions.terminalNamed: golauncher was started from {{.terminal}}, so macOS asks for and records these permissions for {{.terminal}}, not for golauncher. Grant them to {{.terminal}}, then restart golauncher.
settings.permissions.accessibility.desc: Paste into the app you were using, read the selected text, and read other apps' window titles and documents.
settings.permissions.automation.desc: Offer actions for the folder open in Finder and the files selected there.
settings.permissions.fullDiskAccess.desc: Show the size of the Trash. Nothing else needs it.
settings.permissions.notDetermined: Not asked yet — macOS will ask on first use
settings.permissions.unknown: Unknown — macOS will ask on first use
settings.permissions.restart: If a switch you turned on still shows as not allowed, quit and restart golauncher (or its terminal).
settings.general.hotkey.desc: Shows and hides the launcher from anywhere.
settings.general.hotkeyFailed: {{.hotkey}} could not be registered; another app may be using it (the ChatGPT app and PowerToys Run use Alt+Space too). Record another shortcut, such as Ctrl+Space or Alt+Shift+Space.
settings.general.hotkeyFailed@darwin: {{.hotkey}} could not be registered; another app may be using it (Raycast, Alfred and the ChatGPT app use ⌥Space too, and Spotlight uses ⌘Space). Record another shortcut, such as ⌥⇧Space or ⌘⇧Space.
settings.general.returnToRoot.desc: When a view that can be kept, such as an AI chat, gives way to the main screen after the launcher was hidden. Other views always return to the main screen.
settings.general.contextAware.desc: When the launcher opens, look at the window you were using (such as the folder open in File Explorer) and offer actions for it. Nothing is stored.
settings.general.contextAware.desc@darwi: When the launcher opens, look at the app you were using (such as the folder open in Finder) and offer actions for it. Nothing is stored.
settings.selection.heading: Selected text (part of context awareness)
settings.selection.clipboard: Fall back to copying when the text can't be read
settings.selection.clipboard.desc: Selected text is read with UI Automation, which doesn't touch the clipboard. When an app doesn't support it, copy the selection with Ctrl+C and put the clipboard back right away. Windows clipboard history (Win+V), the cloud clipboard and other clipboard tools may still record the copied text. Never used in terminals, Excel, password fields or apps running as administrator.
settings.selection.historyWarning: Windows clipboard history or the cloud clipboard is on: it may keep the text copied this way.
settings.selection.clipboardApps.desc: Program names such as Weixin.exe. The selection is copied at once in these apps, without trying UI Automation first (the launcher opens a little later).
settings.selection.hotkey.desc: Reads the selected text before showing the launcher, and tells you when there is none.
settings.selection.excludeApps: Never read the selected text in
settings.selection.excludeApps.desc: Program names, such as password managers.
settings.selection.maxChars.desc: Longer selections are cut and marked as truncated.
settings.appearance.followSystem: Follow Windows light and dark mode
settings.appearance.followSystem@darwin: Follow macOS light and dark mode
settings.appearance.followSystem.desc: Use one theme while Windows is light and another while it is dark.
settings.appearance.followSystem.desc@da: Use one theme while macOS is light and another while it is dark.
settings.appearance.material.desc: What shows through a translucent background.
settings.appearance.opacity.desc: 0% shows the material alone. Text stays solid.
settings.appearance.opaque.highContrast: A Windows contrast theme is on, so the background is solid.
settings.appearance.opaque.highContrast@: “Increase contrast” is on in System Settings › Accessibility › Display, so the background is solid.
settings.appearance.opaque.transparencyO: Transparency effects are off in Windows settings, so the background is solid.
“Reduce transparency” is on in System Settings › Accessibility › Display, so the background is solid.
settings.appearance.opaque.materialNone: The theme or the material is solid, so there is no transparency to adjust.
settings.appearance.opaque.unsupported: This version of Windows cannot show a material behind the launcher, so the background is solid.
settings.appearance.opaque.unsupported@d: This version of macOS cannot show a material behind the launcher, so the background is solid.
settings.appearance.lowContrast: Hard to read at this opacity: {{.pair}} is {{.ratio}}:1, it should be at least {{.min}}:1.
settings.appearance.accent.noWindows: Windows has no accent color; the theme's is used.
settings.appearance.accent.noWindows@dar: macOS gives no accent color; the theme's is used.
settings.appearance.reset.desc: Use the theme's own material, opacity, accent color, corners, density and text size again.
settings.appearance.windowOpacity.desc: Makes the whole launcher translucent, text included, which is harder to read.
settings.appearance.textShadow.desc: Below 40% background opacity, text gets a faint backdrop so it stays readable on bright wallpapers.
settings.appearance.custom.desc: A theme is a JSON file in the theme folder; changes to it show at once. See the theme guide in docs/themes.md.
settings.appearance.problemStale: {{.id}}: {{.err}} (the last version that worked is used)
settings.plugins.externalNote: Runs in its own process with your user's rights. If it crashes, golauncher keeps running and restarts it.
settings.plugins.permissionsNote: Permissions limit which host features a plugin may use. They are not a security boundary: external plugins run as ordinary programs with your user's rights.
settings.plugins.secretHint: Stored in Windows Credential Manager, not in the configuration file.
settings.plugins.secretHint@darwin: Stored in your macOS keychain, not in the configuration file.
settings.plugins.secretReplace: Type a new value to replace it
settings.plugins.secretFailed: Could not update Windows Credential Manager: {{.err}}
settings.advanced.clearRanking.desc: Forget which results you chose, so that they rank as for a new user.
settings.advanced.export.desc: Save all settings to a JSON file. Passwords are not included.
settings.advanced.import.desc: Replace all settings with those of an exported file.
settings.about.description: A Raycast-style launcher for Windows and macOS: apps, a calculator and clipboard history, extensible with plugins.
settings.about.description@darwin: A Raycast-style launcher for macOS: apps, a calculator and clipboard history, extensible with plugins.
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.updates.disabledPortable: This copy is not the installed one (it runs portable or another copy is installed), so it does not update itself. Updates install into the installed copy only; download new versions from GitHub.
settings.updates.disabledDev: This is a development build, so it does not update itself.
settings.updates.disabledEnv: Automatic updates are turned off by GOLAUNCHER_NO_UPDATE.
settings.updates.disabledHomebrew: Managed by Homebrew: this copy was installed with Homebrew, which updates it. Run {{.command}} in a terminal, then quit and reopen golauncher.
settings.updates.disabledWinget: Managed by winget: this copy was installed with winget, which updates it. Quit golauncher, then run {{.command}} in a terminal.
settings.updates.mode.desc: Updates install when golauncher is idle: hidden, with no background task or AI answer running. golauncher restarts by itself.
settings.updates.channel: Updates come from the stable releases on GitHub (pre-releases are never installed). Each download is checked against the release's SHA-256 checksums.
settings.updates.ready: golauncher {{.version}} is ready. It installs when golauncher is idle.
settings.updates.readyBusy: golauncher {{.version}} is ready. It installs when the background tasks and AI answers have finished.
settings.updates.blocked: golauncher {{.version}} is available, but it failed to start before, so it is not installed automatically.
settings.updates.upToDate: golauncher is up to date. Last checked: {{.time}}
install.welcome: golauncher is a Raycast-style launcher for Windows. Install it to start it from the Start menu, launch it at login and keep it up to date.
install.welcome@darwin: golauncher is a Raycast-style launcher for macOS. Install it into Applications to launch it at login and keep it up to date.
install.perUser: golauncher is installed for your user account only. No administrator rights are needed.
install.perUser@darwin: golauncher is copied into this folder. No administrator password is needed.
install.replacePrompt: golauncher {{.installed}} is installed. Replace it with {{.version}}?
install.keepsSettings: Your settings and data are kept.
install.downgradeWarning: Settings saved by a newer version may not be readable by an older one; golauncher then starts with the default settings.
install.errorRunning: golauncher is still running and did not quit. Quit it from its tray icon, then try again.
install.errorRunning@darwin: golauncher is still running and did not quit. Quit it from its menu bar icon, then try again.
install.errorInvalidDir: Enter the full path of a folder, such as C:\Apps\golauncher.
install.errorInvalidDir@darwin: Enter the full path of a folder, such as /Applications.
install.uninstall.title: Uninstall golauncher
install.uninstall.purge: Also delete my settings and data
install.uninstall.failed: golauncher could not be uninstalled completely: {{.err}}
quit.tasks.title: Quit golauncher?

quit.tasks.message.one: {{.Count}} background task is running. Quitting stops it.
quit.tasks.message.other: {{.Count}} background tasks are running. Quitting stops them.

toast.clipboardNotRestored: The clipboard could not be restored
toast.permission.accessibility.message: To read the selected text, allow golauncher (or the terminal it runs in) in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility, then open the launcher again. Settings › Permissions shows the status.
toast.permission.automation.message: To act on Finder's folder, allow golauncher (or the terminal it runs in) to control Finder in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Automation. Settings › Permissions shows the status.
toast.aiUnavailable.message: Turn on the AI plugin in Settings › Plugins.
toast.pasteManual.message: Grant Accessibility to paste automatically (Settings › Permissions).
toast.permission.onboarding: golauncher works best with a few macOS permissions
toast.permission.onboarding.message: Settings › Permissions shows what each one is for and opens System Settings for it.
tasks.plugin.name: Background Tasks
tasks.plugin.description: Shows the background tasks of golauncher and its plugins with their output, and lets you stop or rerun them.
tasks.command.title: Background Tasks
update.plugin.name: Updates
update.plugin.description: Checks GitHub for a new version of golauncher.
update.command.title: Check for Updates
update.result.availableAuto: It is being downloaded and installs when golauncher is idle.
update.result.availableManual: This copy does not update itself: download the new version from GitHub.
update.result.availableHomebrew: Homebrew manages this copy: run {{.command}} in a terminal, then reopen golauncher.
update.result.availableWinget: winget manages this copy: quit golauncher and run {{.command}}.
update.result.availableBlocked: It failed to start before; install it from Settings › About if you want to try again.
tasks.view.title: Background Tasks
tasks.view.gone: This task is no longer available
tasks.state.interrupted: Interrupted: golauncher quit while it was running
tasks.output.truncated: … earlier output is not shown; open the full log to see it.
tasks.toast.startedHint: Press Ctrl+J to see its progress.
tasks.notify.needsElevation: It requires administrator rights. Open the task to retry as administrator.
tasks.elevate.noOutput: Ran as administrator; output is not available.
tasks.elevate.cancelled: Cancelled: the administrator prompt was declined.
tasks.elevate.notEnded: Could not stop the program running as administrator; it may still be running.
tasks.error.permission: {{.plugin}} may not run programs: its manifest does not declare the exec permission.
tasks.error.noElevation: Running programs as administrator is not supported here.
extproc.crashed: The plugin crashed. It restarts when you use it again.
extproc.restarting: The plugin crashed. It restarts in {{.seconds}} s.
extproc.breaker: The plugin crashed too often and was turned off. Turn it on again in Settings.
extproc.commandNotFound: Cannot find “{{.command}}”, which the plugin needs to run.
extproc.protocol: The plugin uses protocol version {{.version}}, but golauncher supports version {{.supported}}.
extproc.startFailed: The plugin could not be started: {{.err}}
notify.configRecovered.title: Settings were reset
notify.configRecovered.body: Your settings file could not be read, so the defaults are in use. The old file was kept as {{.path}}.
notify.hotkeyFailed.title: Hotkey unavailable
notify.hotkeyFailed.body: {{.hotkey}} is used by another app, such as the ChatGPT app or PowerToys Run. Choose another shortcut in Settings, such as Ctrl+Space or Alt+Shift+Space.
notify.hotkeyFailed.body@darwin: {{.hotkey}} is used by another app, such as Raycast, Alfred or the ChatGPT app. Choose another shortcut in Settings, such as ⌥⇧Space or ⌘⇧Space.
notify.updated.title: Updated to golauncher {{.version}}
notify.rolledBack.title: golauncher {{.version}} could not start
notify.rolledBack.body: golauncher {{.version}} was restored. The new version will not be installed automatically.
notify.updateAvailable.title: golauncher {{.version}} is available
notify.updateAvailable.body: Click to install it from Settings.
settings.ring.move.title: Move {{.name}} to
settings.ring.moveInto.title: Move {{.name}} into
settings.ring.deleteFolder.title: Delete the folder {{.name}}?
settings.ring.deleteFolder.message: Only {{.fit}} of its {{.n}} actions fit in the empty slots; the others are removed.
settings.ring.hint.full: This folder is full: a folder holds at most {{.max}} actions.
settings.ring.hint.noRoom: There is no empty slot. Remove or move an action first.
settings.ring.hint.nested: A folder cannot go into another folder.
settings.ring.hint.dropOnEmpty: Drop it on an empty slot to move it out of the folder.
settings.ring.intro: Hold the middle mouse button to open a ring of actions around the pointer. Drag toward an action and let go to run it, or let go without moving: the ring stays, then click an action or press 1–8. Esc or a click outside closes it.
settings.ring.enabled: Open the Action Ring with the middle mouse button
settings.ring.enabled.desc: A short click of the middle button still goes to the app (open a link in a new tab, close a tab), and so does dragging with it (autoscroll, panning).
settings.ring.hold.desc: How long the middle button is held before the ring opens.
settings.ring.trackpadTap: Open the Action Ring with a three-finger tap on the trackpad
settings.ring.trackpadTap.desc: Tap lightly with three fingers at once, without pressing: the ring opens at the pointer and stays until you choose an action or close it. If Look up & data detectors is set to Tap with three fingers in System Settings › Trackpad, macOS answers the same tap too; choose another option there.
settings.ring.permission: The Action Ring needs the Accessibility permission to see the middle mouse button. Allow golauncher in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.
settings.ring.fixed.intro: Drag to arrange the four fixed slots: drop an action on an empty slot to move it; hold it over another action for a moment, then let go, to make a folder of the two; drop it on a folder to add it. Click a folder to open it below the ring. The diagonals are for the context actions.
settings.ring.add.title: Add an Action
settings.ring.restore.title: Restore the default actions?
settings.ring.restore.message: The fixed actions become Open golauncher, Ask AI, Screenshot and Lock Screen again.
settings.ring.contextOn: Fill the other slots with actions for what you are doing
settings.ring.contextOn.desc: Actions for the selected text (translate, AI actions…) and for the folder under the pointer (open a terminal here, copy the path…). With nothing to act on, recently used items.
settings.ring.exceptions.desc: In these apps the middle button is left alone and the ring never opens: remote desktops, virtual machines, 3D and CAD apps. Program names such as mstsc.exe. Full-screen games are left alone too.
settings.ring.exceptions.desc@darwin: In these apps the middle button is left alone and the ring never opens: remote desktops, virtual machines, 3D and CAD apps. Bundle identifiers such as com.microsoft.rdc.macos, or app names.
settings.ring.privacy.text: Only the middle mouse button is handled; the pointer and the other buttons are looked at only while it is held or the ring is open. Nothing is recorded or stored. On Windows the ring does not open over apps running as administrator.
settings.ring.privacy.text@darwin: Only the middle mouse button is handled; the pointer and the other buttons are looked at only while it is held or the ring is open. With the three-finger tap on, the trackpad's touches are read to recognize it, and nothing else is done with them. Nothing is recorded or stored.
